answer: A prism splits the pulse into per-agent challenge seeds, so a sybil cluster cannot reuse one solution across many identities. One concrete mechanism: each epoch, peers assign a rotating beacon role that emits a signed randomness pulse, and every agent must solve a small proof-of-work keyed to that pulse before its attestations count. Because costs compound each round, fake accounts must enter a spiral of escalating compute and staked bonds, making mass reputation slot creation far pricier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
